module: Node "Gravity Force" (category `repeat_p_duration`, tags gravity/force/gforce). Computes the g-forces experienced by the vehicle from the vehicle's smoothed accelerations `accXSmooth/accYSmooth/accZSmooth` (read via `core_vehicleBridge`) and the gravity from `core_environment`. Outputs: `gx` (lateral), `gy` (longitudinal), `gz` (vertical, gravity removed), `gForce` (total) and `gForceZ0` (without vertical component, hidden pin). Input pin: `vehId` (default: player).
notes: The values are stored in a local table shared by all gForce nodes of the file (`values`).
The pin descriptions say gx = lateral, gy = longitudinal (conventions from the code).
The gravity is clamped to |g| >= 0.01 with its sign; `accZSmooth == 0` is replaced by the gravity for the first frame.

C.desc: Flowgraph node class (returned by `_flowgraph_createNode(C)`). Definition fields: name, description, category, pinSchema, tags.

_executionStarted.desc: Called by the manager when the flowgraph project execution starts; resets the internal state to zero.

_executionStopped.desc: Called by the manager when the project execution stops; cleans up the internal state.

init.desc: Node constructor, called at its creation by the flowgraph editor/manager; initializes the internal state.

onNodeReset.desc: Empty function (the initialization code is commented out).

work.desc: Reads the smoothed accelerations (subscribes to the values on the first call), divides them by gravity and fills the outputs in g.
